display.purpose: Landing hero; preserve responsive final overrides.

identifier.purpose: Record IDs, evidence references and field keys.

motion.name: dialog-entry
motion.purpose: Opacity and translateY(15px) scale(.97) to rest.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Continuous presentation labels; shared pause state freezes CSS animation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS fallback; GSAP omitted; videos/scanner initially paused; proof layer hidden.

motion.name: inspection-scroll
motion.purpose: Scroll separates payment, rule, journal and verified-finding dossier layers; one mounted explanation.

motion.name: work-tab-entry
motion.purpose: Orient the next working surface without opacity hiding.

motion.name: cinema-continuity
motion.purpose: Move only the video within a borderless frame; dissolve its lower edge into the graphite finale.

dialogBehavior: Initial focus enters first enabled visible control.
Tab and Shift-Tab cycle within the dialog.
Background workspace-header and work-content are inert.
Focus returns to the invoking element if still connected.

responsive.phone: Single-column sections and episode layout; 18px workspace side padding; 16px input text; scrollable top tabs and tables; auth visual hidden.
responsive.cascade: Final readability and responsive blocks override earlier rules.

presentationBehavior.pause: Shared landing state pauses marquee, all landing videos and Scanner; scroll-linked GSAP remains scroll-driven.
presentationBehavior.scanner: Visibility-gated Three.js drawing; pointer-oriented lens; pale paper, steel, dark rings and cyan scan line.
presentationBehavior.fontPolicy: Installed SF Pro only; self-hosted Manrope Latin/Cyrillic/Cyrillic-ext fallback; no Apple font redistribution.

provenance.mode: Extracted final implementation; synthesized tonal ramps are preview metadata only.
provenance.limitations: No whole-surface rendered review verdict or official score asserted.

narrative.northStar: Apple-style product demonstration translated to financial evidence
narrative.overview:
The implemented world translates the user’s Apple Vision Pro video reference into financial evidence: generous cool-white space, large typography, physical document scenes and restrained blue actions. Presentation is cinematic; the investigation workspace carries the same type and materials into denser, legible tools.

Depth explains inspection and linked records. A metallic scanner and layered papers carry the visual signature; the working interface uses quiet borders and tonal grouping so records, evidence and remaining steps stay readable. This is the implemented system extracted from code, not a new visual proposal.
keyCharacteristics: Detailed physical evidence dossier with four scroll-separated layers
Transparent target tutorial with arrow and real actions
RU, KK and EN with reduced-motion alternatives

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, selected navigation and interaction cues; keep document materials predominantly neutral.

rules.name: The Local Font Rule
rules.body: Use SF Pro only through installed system fonts. Serve the bundled Manrope fallback; do not redistribute Apple fonts.

rules.name: The Evidence Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve pronounced perspective and cast shadows for documents and focused overlays. Keep ordinary workspace panels border-led.

dos: Do preserve the final CSS cascade when copying typography and responsive rules.
Do keep visible focus on interactive controls and restore focus when a focused tool closes.
Do let workspace tabs and data tables scroll within their own containers on small screens.
Do connect pause controls to the marquee, videos and scanner and honor reduced motion.
Do use tabular numerals for budgets, amounts and metrics.
donts: Don't distribute SF Pro font files.
Don't place essential instructions inside decorative WebGL or video scenes.
Don't copy oversized desktop headings into mobile layouts without their overrides.
Don't use cinematic paper shadows as the default treatment for every work panel.
Don't turn local evaluation results into an official judging claim.
